en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moallad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Jamhour, from Abdullah Bin Abdul Rahman, from Al Haysam Bin Waqid, from Abu Yusuf Al Bazzal who said,
[7:69] therefore remember the Favours of Allah, that you may be successful.
Heasws said: ‘Do you know what is the Favour of Allahazwj?’ I said, ‘No’. Heasws said: ‘It is the most Magnificent Bounty upon Hisazwj creatures, and it is ourasws Wilayah’.
en.sarwar: 3. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Jumhur from ‘Adallah ibn ’Abd al-Rahman from al-Haytham ibn Waqid from abu Yusuf al-Bazzaz who has said that
“Keep in mind the bounties of Allah. .” [7:69]

The Imams (a.s.) said, “Do you know what the bounties of Allah are?” I said, “No, I do not know.” He said, “It is the greatest of the bounties of Allah. It is to acknowledge the Divine authority that we possess.”
